text:
kelly-design: quick thread: proposing a small IA shift to make deep links more predictable. Top groups: Resources (Models, Datasets, Secrets), Serving (Endpoints, Rollouts), Insights (Logs, Metrics, Alerts). Main q: should subviews be path-segment first (`/console/models/:id/deployments`) or keep `?tab=`?

noam-eng: path segments for sure. easier to bookmark/share and avoids parsing querystrings for page identity. keep query params for filters only. We can add server redirects from `?tab=` to new paths.

julia-px: agree with paths. copy notes: use singular left-nav labels (Model, Dataset) and full phrase H1s like "Model details". breadcrumbs should read: "Models > ResNet-XL > Deployments" and each crumb should be linkable. tiny nit: replace any "master" text with "primary" before we ship.

ari-sre: a11y/routing checklist: on deep-link landing, focus moves to H1; expose a skip-to-content link visible on focus; ensure `aria-current="page"` on active leaf nav item; when auto-expanding a collapsed nav group for a deep link, do not move keyboard focus into the nav, keep it on H1. use `aria-live="polite"` for short announcements only.

noam-eng: impl notes: generate routes from the nav config and emit a mapping table {pattern -> navGroupKey} to compute active state cleanly. for legacy `?tab=` we should prefer a server-side 301 for bots, fallback to client redirect for browsers while recording original URL in telemetry to preserve attribution. avoid double fetch on client redirect by resolving canonical path server-side when possible.

julia-px: UX edgecase: anchors like `/models/12#perf` are handy. propose client-side handling for hashes (smooth-scroll after hydration). server should return canonical path (no hash) and client restores anchor. document behaviour in routing guide.

kelly-design: small prototype sketch: `/console/models/:modelId` -> overview, `/console/models/:modelId/deployments`, `/console/models/:modelId/versions/:versionId`. canonicalize those. I'll update mocks and include a one-paragraph a11y checklist for eng.

route-bot: PR opened: `nav/paths-and-aria` -> reviewers: @kelly-design @noam-eng. CI: lint + a11y smoke tests.

ari-sre: also capture incoming raw URL (query + hash) in telemetry before redirect so experiments don't lose attribution.

kelly-design: thanks — will post updated wireframes and a short copy sheet. :thumbsup:
